|{3:-} {4:[ ]} open item|
|{3:-} {5:[X]} done item|
|{3:-} {6:[-]} partial item|
|  {3:1.} ordered child|
|  {3:2)} other child|
|{3:+} {7:term} :: description|
|{1:* Fancy}|
|{3:-} {4:[ ]} icon|
|{3:-} {5:[X]} icon|

{1} OrgHeadlineLevel1 -> Title [bold]
{2} OrgStatistic -> OrgTodo -> @comment.error
{3} OrgListBullet -> Special
{4} OrgCheckbox -> Special
{5} OrgCheckboxChecked -> DiagnosticOk
{6} OrgCheckboxPartial -> DiagnosticWarn
{7} OrgListTerm [bold]
